status: Frozen prospectively by root before acquisition; not yet executed
scope: Immutable captured native-input storage component only; no production integration, complete-import latency claim, or browser peak-memory claim.

retainedCapture.availability: Local original volume unavailable; root auditing archived checkpoint. Regeneration must independently reproduce retained structural and binary source witnesses.

contentSeed.boundary: Complete baseline corpus content tail, not each group's real import-time tail.
contentSeed.adapter: Fresh lazy file-backed adapter each observation; reads occur on slice().arrayBuffer(), not during prepare; fresh ordinary read caches.

arms.A: Unchanged frozen record sink on original complete native chunks/resolved references.
arms.B: Same sink; for immutable captured mixed groups only, canonical raw reads, real existing-latch compressed aliases, private record-only reference overlay, original whole native prepared lookup payload. No global canonical metadata/cache promotion.
arms.C: Identical source and behavior to A; independent fresh process.

setupOutsideTiming: Hash and validate source, lock, runtime and exact captured binary inputs; preserve original object/buffer aliases.
Create fresh content and record stores using normal production-derived geometry/budgets; copy exact complete content seed to private output; initialize empty ordinary read caches.
Initialize normal codec lifecycle equally for every arm. No candidate-only codec calls, cached alias reads, record-encoder warmups or tiny-append prewarm.
Restore exact original firstId gaps before each selected group without changing persisted row IDs; source/capture loading and explicit GC remain outside timing.
primaryEndpoint: One monotonic elapsed interval covering all10 real record sink calls plus mandatory recordStore.endImportSession() and contentStore.endImportSession(). B includes all candidate selection/validation, canonical reads, tiny compression/append, overlays and physical write drainage. No parallel cohorts or background heavy study.
codecScope: Existing wrapped batch implementation uses the initialized owner-thread codec for a one-block alias. Do not force a different worker path, change codec/level/block targets or bypass the dictionary selection latch.
diagnostics: Per-group append elapsed; alias logical read requests/returned bytes; actual lazy file read calls/bytes; alias pack/compress/envelope/reference/append counters; record encode/lookup/field/validation counters; finalization elapsed; process CPU delta; bounded buffer/copy byte accounting.
Counters with overlapping lifetimes are not summed as a serial budget. Memory receipts and allocation counts are not browser peak memory.

witnesses.aliasFixedBytesRule: Eight one-entry blocks; each12-byte envelope +20-byte compact reference. Zstd frame bytes are additional and measured.
witnesses.semantic: Every400000 row retains original global ID, expression/reading bytes and equality sentinel, score, normalized sequence, full definition bytes and lookup/posting behavior; compare full decoded sidecars and cold reopened reads outside timing.
witnesses.physical: A/C whole physical outputs must be deterministic and equal. B is allowed a distinct explicitly recorded layout; each whole prepared lookup payload must match the original native map bytes exactly; completed seed prefix stays byte-identical; actual alias bytes/frames and record/header sizes reconcile. No A/B physical-byte-equality claim.
witnesses.ownership: All source columns/bytes/maps are hash-guarded before and after every observation; generic callers and post-await mutation semantics are outside this immutable experiment and remain a blocking production design gate.

eligibilityRules: No dictionary-name or two-entry special case in implementation.
Only an actually mixed group with existing compressed target descriptor and supported raw descriptors; uniform raw/target groups keep A behavior.
Only validated captured native whole prepared map/owned stable columns; no generic map-shape shortcut or factory-origin-as-immutability claim.
Use existing selected-dictionary latch and source/format bounds; retain ordinary4GiB offset-span fallback without forcing whole maps.
No alias changes to canonical dedup IDs, hash tables, cache mappings or logical dedup counters; snapshot/check any available seeded metadata outside timing.
Apply the frozen aliasAdmissionBounds; reject other formats or larger sets without partially appending any aliases.
failurePolicy: Preserve exact commands, sources, seed/capture identities, stdout/stderr, observations acquired so far and failure. No selective rerun; setup/correctness/route failure invalidates performance qualification. Finish or drain every initiated read/append before close/rollback.

statistics: All36 raw observations and per-group durations.
Within each block B/A and B/C ratios and absolute differences; medians, faster-pair counts, equal-work sums and same-code C/A separately.
No pooling with previous subset, other hosts, old profiles, or future complete-import cohorts.
reporting.decision: Advance only to consider production implementation and a separate fixed complete-browser qualification if every mechanical screen gate below passes. This component never qualifies a PR speed claim.

advanceCriteria.complete: All36 prescribed observations and all source, route, semantic, lookup and storage checks must pass. An incomplete or failed cohort supports no performance conclusion.

bootstrap.sampling: Resample12 complete ABC blocks with replacement, choosing floor(u*12). Use the same resampled block indexes for all statistics in each replicate; preserve within-block pairing.
bootstrap.statistic: Median paired differences and median paired percentage changes, calculated separately against A and C; paired C/A percentage drift retained.
bootstrap.interval: Descriptive95% percentile interval with type7 linear interpolation at0.025 and0.975 over sorted bootstrap medians.
bootstrap.upperBounds: Strictly negative for both millisecond and percentage intervals against each control.
bootstrap.interpretation: Descriptive sensitivity of this fixed12-block cohort, not a claim of population generality.

advanceCriteria.equalWork: Sum of B endpoint durations must be strictly lower than sum of A and strictly lower than sum of C.
advanceCriteria.otherEvidence: Retain every order effect, tail, group duration and A/C observation; no favorable-only reruns or outlier deletion.
advanceCriteria.classification: Any missing validation or observation: failed/incomplete, no performance conclusion. A complete cohort failing any mechanical advance gate: inconclusive for advancement, even if another statistic is favorable. Clear regression may additionally be reported descriptively.
advanceCriteria.endpoint: All thresholds use the same primary10-group pass endpoint including both store finalizations, never selected subphase clocks.

aliasAdmissionBounds.target: One existing target compact-block family in this mixed group.
aliasAdmissionBounds.latch: The existing dictionary compression session must already be selected; baseline selection/savings/block settings remain unchanged.
aliasAdmissionBounds.scope: Prospective immutable component bounds only; not a proposed production policy. No dictionary-name or two-entry special case and no tuning after acquisition.

sourceBindingRule: Before acquisition, freeze a companion manifest containing the exact experiment commit/tree, this protocol blob SHA, runner/adapter/promotion/capture-helper/test hashes, frozen production runtime hashes, fixture/seed/capture hashes and generated support hashes. Refuse any mismatch. No source selection from a mutable branch name. Harness source correction before acquisition must preserve prior source and failed receipts; no mutation after observations begin.
